description: This file defines an abstract repository interface and its implementation for managing locale settings in an e-commerce Flutter app. It includes methods to get, set, and clear locale codes, utilizing a data source for persistent storage.

classes.name: LocaleRepository
classes.description: An abstract interface for locale management, defining methods to get, set, and clear locale information.

classes.name: LocalLocaleRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of LocaleRepository that interacts with a local data source to persist locale data.

methods.name: getLocaleCode
methods.description: Fetches the current locale code from the local data source.

methods.name: setLocaleCode
methods.description: Sets or updates the locale code in the local data source.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the locale code, resetting it to null.
